title: ServerSystemX
description: A Simple Server System, without the useless crap you'll never use!
body:
# ServerSystemX — The Ultimate All-in-One Server Management Plugin
# 
Elevate your Minecraft server with ServerSystemX, the lightweight but powerful plugin packed with essential commands and features every admin needs. From seamless player nicknaming to advanced ban and mute systems with database support, ServerSystemX keeps your server clean, fun, and under control.

Key Features:
​
Effortless player nicking with skin & UUID disguise​
Customizable prefix and messages for a personalized server vibe​
Built-in permission checks for secure admin control​
Lightweight, optimized, and designed for stability on all Spigot/Paper versions​
Why ServerSystemX?

No more juggling dozens of plugins. ServerSystemX combines your core admin tools into one reliable package, saving you time and headaches. Perfect for servers that demand smooth gameplay, fair moderation, and hassle-free management.

You can find the wiki under: https://schleimiger.gitbook.io/schleimiger-docs/
